prompt: The World Wide Web — pages linked by hyperlinks, viewed in a browser — was invented in 1989 by which scientist?
explanation: Tim Berners-Lee, working at CERN, invented the World Wide Web in 1989 and gave the technology away freely, which helped it spread worldwide.
